summary: Native-share verification: 32/32 production-invoking tests pass (shareVideoFile 9, exportMime 5, exportVisibility 6, replayTransport 12); typecheck clean. AC-NS-1/4/5/6/8 seams covered by injectable canShare/share fakes; non-test callers confirmed. Gesture/UI ACs (2/3/7/9 + UI timing) residual per stage note.
goal: After downloading climb replay video, allow sharing via Apple & Android native share sheets (Web Share API files).

coverageMatrix.evidence: canShareVideoFile true with files-only payload (no title/text); false when canShare missing/false/throws. Bar mounts Share when canShareVideoFile(file) — mount itself residual (no RTL).
Share button className includes min-h-[44px] min-w-[44px]; no layout measurement test.
Share JSX only under exportStatus.kind===success; bar unmounted when not replaying (ClimbScene). No automated render gate.
shareVideoFile invokes share with files:[file] (+ optional title); unsupported skips share. Gesture-negative (no auto-share on onstop) is structural in useReplayExport — residual for click/RTL proof.
AbortError → { ok:false, reason:'aborted' }. Bar treats aborted as quiet (no shareError). UI ≤500ms residual.
NotAllowedError → reason error with non-empty message; empty message falls back to 'Share failed'. Bar setShareError(message). UI ≤2s residual.
onstop builds File([blob], filename, {type:containerMime}) and sets success.file; dismissStatus → idle drops reference. No unit asserting byte length/name/type retention or dismiss release.
WebM File.type video/webm in canShare probe and share payload; .webm name; never forged mp4. Parent pickExportMime label/extension honesty still green.
On result.ok bar calls speak('Share complete') which appends monotonic announceSeq; aria-live polite region present. No unit for announce text.
onstop always downloadBlob then setStatus success (share additive). MIME honesty via pickExportMime. Download trigger itself residual (DOM <a download>).

testResults.command: cd /workspace/app && pnpm exec vitest run tests/game/shareVideoFile.test.ts tests/game/exportMime.test.ts tests/game/exportVisibility.test.ts tests/game/replayTransport.test.ts

residualRisks: AC-NS-2 44×44 hit-target — CSS classes only; needs layout/RTL or manual measure.
AC-NS-3 Share absent off success / live play — wiring residual; ClimbScene gate untested.
AC-NS-4 negative auto-share — structural (no share in onstop); no fake asserting share not called on success transition.
AC-NS-5/6 UI timing windows (500ms / 2s) and quiet vs alert rendering — bar wiring residual.
AC-NS-7 File retention byte-equality + dismiss/new-export release — hook residual (encode browser).
AC-NS-9 Share complete aria-live + monotonic suffix — speak() wiring residual.
AC-NS-10 download trigger DOM residual; share-hidden UA still downloads — QA device check.
NFR-NS-2 ≤100ms click→share start — not timed in unit suite.

learnings.insight: Native-share verifier: 32 production-invoking tests pass (shareVideoFile 9, exportMime 5, exportVisibility 6, replayTransport 12); pnpm typecheck pass. AC-NS-1/4/5/6/8 covered by injectable canShare/share fakes; AC-NS-2/3/7/9 residual UI/hook.
learnings.action: Advance to reviewer; QA should device-check Share sheet on iOS/Android and confirm no Share on desktop canShare=false.

learnings.insight: shareVideoFile non-test caller is ReplayTransportBar only; File retention lives in useReplayExport success.file and is independent of download URL revoke — units correctly assert MIME/name on the File, not object-URL liveness.
learnings.action: Do not require revoke-timing tests for AC-NS-7; if retention must be unit-proven later, export a buildExportFile helper or test File construction with injectable blob seams.

learnings.insight: Gesture/UI ACs (Share mount, 44px, announce, no auto-share on success transition) are intentionally residual when canShare/share/Abort seams are thoroughly unit-covered; click→share activation cannot be proven without RTL/browser.
learnings.action: QA: cancel sheet → no error; fulfill share → hear/see Share complete; encode complete without tap → no sheet.

appliedLearnings: Invoked canShareVideoFile/shareVideoFile with fakes — no navigator.share source greps
Asserted files-only probe and WebM video/webm MIME (implementer + architect pings)
Confirmed non-test callers before counting AC coverage
Left gesture/UI ACs residual per user stage instruction when seams covered
Did not require download object URL to remain live for share (File owns bytes)
